comment: Defects the edit flow shows today (tests/e2e/edit-flow.py). One entry per defect, with every gating check it turns red. A listed check that passes fails the suite until it is removed from its entry (the report prints FIXED).

failures.bug: KiCad save writes a copper arc as straight segments: demo.kicad_pcb has (arc (start 20 20) (mid 21.46 23.54) (end 25 25)) on F.Cu; the saved file has 16 (segment ...) chords and no arc (app/formats/kicad-export.js segments()). KiCad reads 16 tracks; top copper differs by 0.26 mm2

KiCad save rewrites parametric pads as custom polygons: an oval through-hole pad (size 1.7 2.2), a trapezoid (rect_delta), a chamfered rectangle and a custom pad with its 0.5 mm anchor all come back as (pad ... custom (size 0.01 0.01) ... gr_poly). The copper outline is kept; the pad's shape, size and anchor are not

KiCad save writes a copper arc as straight segments: demo.kicad_pcb has (arc (start 20 20) (mid 21.46 23.54) (end 25 25)) on F.Cu; the saved file has 16 (segment ...) chords and no arc (app/formats/kicad-export.js segments()). KiCad reads 16 tracks; top copper differs by 0.26 mm2; and after an edit: kiCad save writes the stored zone fill unchanged after an edit: the (filled_polygon ...) text is byte-identical before and after moving a via and a footprint, while Waffle's own fabrication outputs repour first. The saved board carries copper around the old positions until KiCad refills (bottom copper differs by 47-57 mm2)
needs triage: an Altium board saved as KiCad has 3 zones where the Waffle project has 2 pours (a netted VCC_5V copper region on the bottom layer is written as a zone)

needs triage: an unedited Altium board saved as KiCad and imported again plots 7.8 mm2 differently on both outer copper layers; the difference grows with every edit (14-43 mm2), which includes the stale zone fill
